message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure to the southbound opposing missiles while its own missile is already in flight by completing a hard right turn onto an easterly beam and then holding that lateral course, preserving speed as the formations continue closing.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks first to sustain the northbound engagement behind its already-flying missile, then to improve survival against the closing southbound threat by diving, accelerating, and committing to a hard right turn that shifts it northeast off the direct approach."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure to the southbound opposing missiles while its own missile is already in flight by completing a hard right turn onto an easterly beam and then holding that lateral course, preserving speed as the formations continue closing.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks first to sustain the northbound engagement behind its already-flying missile, then to improve survival against the closing southbound threat by diving, accelerating, and committing to a hard right turn that shifts it northeast off the direct approach.
